snippet.title: This is Jump King Quest
snippet.description:
We're adding a dueling system, new bosses, revamped stats, progression, balancing, new weapons and equipment, THE WORKS!

1.0 Phantom update finally launches in less than two weeks on May 25th
Wishlist: https://store.steampowered.com/app/2317640/JUMP_KING_QUEST/

Nexile is an indie game studio located in Uppsala, Sweden. 100% independent 100% self funded!! The new update is gonna go hard!
